text.en: Ultra-Compact, Fits Any Car Glove Box
text.zh: 超紧凑设计，可放入任何车内手套箱
HEPA可水洗过滤器，可重复使用

applications.zh: 家庭, 汽车, 办公室, 厨房

description.en:
Our car vacuums deliver powerful 120W suction in a compact, cordless design — perfect for keeping your vehicle spotless. The 2-in-1 vacuum and blower function handles dust, crumbs, and debris in every corner of your car.

Key features include Type-C fast charging, 12000Pa suction, HEPA filter, LED lighting for dark areas, and a 45-minute runtime. The lightweight 460g body is easy to handle, and the crevice nozzle reaches tight spaces between seats.

As an OEM/ODM manufacturer, we offer custom colors, branding, and packaging to fit your market. MOQ 500 units, sample available in 7-14 days.
description.zh:
我们的车载吸尘器以紧凑无线的设计提供120W强劲吸力，让您的爱车保持一尘不染。吸吹二合一功能处理车内各个角落的灰尘、碎屑。

核心功能包括Type-C快充、12000Pa吸力、HEPA滤网、暗处LED照明和45分钟续航。460g轻量机身易于操控，缝隙吸嘴可深入座椅之间狭窄空间。

作为OEM/ODM制造商，我们提供定制颜色、品牌和包装。最小起订量500台，样品7-14天。
